moves.name: Bitter Blade
moves.description:
Fire (Physical)
Base Power: 90
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 4
The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

moves.name: Phantom Force
moves.description:
Ghost (Physical)
Base Power: 90
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
If this move is successful, it breaks through the target's Baneful Bunker, Detect, King's Shield, Protect, or Spiky Shield for this turn, allowing other Pokemon to attack the target normally. If the target's side is protected by Crafty Shield, Mat Block, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard, that protection is also broken for this turn and other Pokemon may attack the target's side normally. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

moves.name: Ally Switch
moves.description:
Psychic (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 2
The user swaps positions with its ally. Fails if the user is the only Pokemon on its side. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails or if the user's last move used is not Ally Switch.

items.name: Colbur Berry
items.description: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Dark-type attack. Single use.

items.name: Life Orb
items.description: Holder's attacks do 1.3x damage, and it loses 1/10 its max HP after the attack.

items.name: Focus Sash
items.description: If holder's HP is full, will survive an attack that would KO it with 1 HP. Single use.

items.name: Sitrus Berry
items.description: Restores 1/4 max HP when at 1/2 max HP or less. Single use.

items.name: Leftovers
items.description: At the end of every turn, holder restores 1/16 of its max HP.

items.name: Choice Scarf
items.description: Holder's Speed is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.

items.name: White Herb
items.description: Restores all lowered stat stages to 0 when one is less than 0. Single use.

items.name: Expert Belt
items.description: Holder's attacks that are super effective against the target do 1.2x damage.

items.name: Quick Claw
items.description: Each turn, holder has a 20% chance to move first in its priority bracket.

abilities.name: Flash Fire
abilities.description: This Pokemon is immune to Fire-type moves. The first time it is hit by a Fire-type move, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Fire-type attack as long as it remains active and has this Ability. If this Pokemon is frozen, it cannot be defrosted by Fire-type attacks.

abilities.name: Weak Armor
abilities.description: If a physical attack hits this Pokemon, its Defense is lowered by 1 stage and its Speed is raised by 2 stages.
